items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: Everybody I listened to was an influence. Benny Carter on alto, and Hodges and Charlie Parker and Lester Young on tenor, and Chu Berry and Hawkins

ctx.x: Yeah. Everybody I listened to was an influence. Benny Carter on alto, and Hodges and Charlie Parker and Lester Young on tenor, and Chu Berry and Hawkins, and now all the guys on trombone. Pee Wee Russell on clarinet. Yeah. Take something from everybody.
So do you work now, I hope this isn’t an obvious question, do you work full time as a musician, as a performer?
